task: I need to evaluate Bitwarden for our 50-person company. I'll start by securely storing a few critical logins like our CRM, a shared social media account, and a secure note for server access. Then, I'll test its sharing capabilities by creating a collection and sharing the social media login with a team member. Finally, I'll organize these entries by adding custom fields and filtering them to see how easily I can manage our growing vault.

observations.what: Sign-up took email + name, an emailed verification link, a master password page whose confirm field shifted down when the strength meter appeared, then an extension prompt and a tour to skip; the '+' alias email was accepted.
The Add button offers Login, Card, Identity, Note, SSH key and Folder in one dropdown, so starting a CRM login or a server-access note took two clicks.
A login or secure note saves with only the Item name filled (username and password optional), so the CRM entry and the server-access note were each created in about three actions.
The personal vault Add menu has no Collection option; sharing requires first creating an organization from a 'New organization' link tucked into the vault filter sidebar.
Custom fields are not visible in the initial Add login dialog view; they sit further down the scrolled form, so I did not reach them in the time I had.
Creating a free organization took a name, a pre-filled billing email, the Free radio and Submit, and immediately produced a 'Default collection' plus a Members page with an Invite member button.
The Free organization is limited to 2 users (including me) and 2 collections, so a 50-person team cannot be evaluated beyond a single teammate without moving to Teams.

After creating the organization the app jumps from Password Manager into a separate Admin Console with its own sidebar, so my saved CRM and note items were not visible where collections and members are managed.
The vault and the org collections view both have a filter panel by type (Login, Card, Identity, Secure note, SSH key), plus Collections, Trash and a search box.
I clicked 'New organization' at a stale coordinate after the list shifted following my two saves, wasting a step.
I ran out of steps before creating the social media login, sharing it to the collection, adding custom fields or filtering the items, so those parts were not tested.
